SELECT tenant_type, t_kb_connection_router.domain_id, knowledge_base_connection_id, tkbc.knowledge_base_used as knowledgeBaseUsed, tkbc.knowledge_base_capacity as knowledgeBaseCapacity FROM t_kb_connection_router LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base_connection as tkbc ON t_kb_connection_router.knowledge_base_connection_id=tkbc.id WHERE tenant_type = #{tenantType}
and t_kb_connection_router.domain_id = #{domainId}

SELECT count(knowledge_base_connection_id) as repoNum, knowledge_base_connection_id, knowledge_base_capacity as totalNum FROM t_knowledge_base LEFT JOIN t_knowledge_base_connection on t_knowledge_base.knowledge_base_connection_id = t_knowledge_base_connection.id WHERE connector_id = 'KooSearchInside' GROUP BY knowledge_base_connection_id, knowledge_base_capacity
